items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: It is Cordilla on clarinet and it's rap on saxophone.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Yeah I've heard those records and it sounds like Cordilla to me on clarinet.
It is Cordilla on clarinet and it's rap on saxophone. On alto saxophone.
Was there one in the title called Pussycat Rag or something? Yeah I made that.
